chapterInfo.content:
2
Nkwagyeɛ kɛseɛ no
1Yei nti ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsɔ nnoɔma a yɛateɛ no mu den ma no boro soɔ, na yɛamfiri ho da bi. 2#Aso 7.53; Gal 3.19 Na sɛ asɛm a wɔnam abɔfoɔ so kaeɛ no timii, na mmarato ne asoɔden biara nyaa n’akatua a ɛsɛ a, 3#Heb 10.29; 12.25 yɛn nso, sɛ yɛammu nkwagyeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛte sɛ yei a, yɛbɛdwane afiri mu sɛn? Ɛno na Awurade firii aseɛ kaeɛ no, wɔn a wɔteeɛ no hyɛɛ mu den maa yɛn, 4#Mar 16.20; 1 Ko 12.4; 12.11 na Onyankopɔn nso de nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne ahoɔdenneɛ ahodoɔ ne Honhom Kronkron a ɔkyekyɛɛ mu sɛ ɔpɛ no dii ho adanseɛ bi.
Yesu nam owuo mu kɔ animuonyam mu
5Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ abɔfoɔ ase na ɔde wiase a ɛreba a yɛka ho asɛm no ahyɛ. 6#Dwom 8.4-6 Na obi di adanseɛ baabi sɛ:
Ɔdasani ne hwan a wokae no,
anaasɛ onipa ba ne hwan a w’ani ku ne ho?
7Woama no aka kakraa bi na wato abɔfoɔ,
wode animuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire,
[na wode no asi wo nsa ano nnwuma so,]#2.7 Tete atwerɛfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn to mu no binom mfa yei nka ho.
8wode nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nan ase.
Na sɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ n’ase yi, wannya biribiara a wamfa anhyɛ n’aseɛ. Na seesei deɛ, yɛnnya nhunuu sɛ wɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ n’ase. 9#Flp 2.8-9 Na mmom, yɛhunu Yesu, deɛ berɛ tiawa bi mu, wɔbrɛɛ no ase senee abɔfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ ɔbɛnam Onyankopɔn adom so bɛka owuo ahwɛ ama nnipa nyinaa. Seesei ɛsiane owuo amanehunu nti, wɔde animuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire.
Ɔnam amanehunu so duru ne pɛyɛ mu
10 # Rom 11.36 Na ɛfataa deɛ ne nti nnoɔma nyinaa wɔ hɔ na ɛnam ne so na nnoɔma nyinaa wɔ hɔ, deɛ ɔde mma bebree baa animuonyam mu no, sɛ ɔde wɔn nkwagyeɛ safohene nam amanehunu mu bɛkɔ pɛyɛ mu.
11 # Mar 3.34-35; Mat 25.40; Yoh 20.17 Na deɛ ɔte ho ne wɔn a wɔte wɔn ho nyinaa wɔ abɔseɛ baako, ne saa nti ɛnyɛ no aniwu sɛ ɔbɛfrɛ wɔn anuanom, 12#Dwom 22.22 sɛ:
Mɛbɔ wo din makyerɛ me nuanom,
asafo mu na mɛto ayeyie dwom mama woɔ.
13 # Yes 8.17; 8.18 Na bio:
Mede me ho bɛto ne so.
Na bio nso:
Hwɛ, me ne mma a Onyankopɔn de wɔn ama me no nie.
Ɔsɔfo Panin Yesu de ɔno ara ne ho bɔ afɔdeɛ
14 # Heb 2.17; 2 Ti 1.10; Yoh 12.31 Enti sɛ mma no anya honam ne mogya korɔ no bie no, saa ara na ɔno nso faa mu bi, sɛ ɔnam owuo so bɛtu deɛ ɔwɔ owuo tumi a ɔne ɔbonsam no, 15na wagye wɔn a anka owuo ho hu nti wɔayɛ nkoa, nna a wɔde te aseɛ nyinaa. 16Na ampa ara, ɛnyɛ abɔfoɔ na ɔsɔ wɔn mu gye wɔn, na mmom Abraham asefoɔ na ɔsɔ wɔn mu gye wɔn. 17#Flp 2.7 Enti ɛhiaa no sɛ ɔsɛ ne nuanom nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na wayɛ mmɔborɔhunu ne nokorɛ sɔfo panin, Nyankopɔn fam nnoɔma no mu, na wayɛ ɔman no bɔne ho mpata. 18#Heb 4.5 Na ɛnam sɛ ɔno ara hunuu sɔ a wɔsɔɔ no hwɛeɛ mu amaneɛ nti, ɔtumi boa wɔn a wɔsɔ wɔn hwɛ no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yei nti ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsɔ nnoɔma a yɛateɛ no mu den ma no boro soɔ, na yɛamfiri ho da bi. Na sɛ asɛm a wɔnam abɔfoɔ so kaeɛ no timii, na mmarato ne asoɔden biara nyaa n’akatua a ɛsɛ a, yɛn nso, sɛ yɛammu nkwagyeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛte sɛ yei a, yɛbɛdwane afiri mu sɛn? Ɛno na Awurade firii aseɛ kaeɛ no, wɔn a wɔteeɛ no hyɛɛ mu den maa yɛn, na Onyankopɔn nso de nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne ahoɔdenneɛ ahodoɔ ne Honhom Kronkron a ɔkyekyɛɛ mu sɛ ɔpɛ no dii ho adanseɛ bi.

Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ abɔfoɔ ase na ɔde wiase a ɛreba a yɛka ho asɛm no ahyɛ. Na obi di adanseɛ baabi sɛ:
Ɔdasani ne hwan a wokae no,
anaasɛ onipa ba ne hwan a w’ani ku ne ho?
Woama no aka kakraa bi na wato abɔfoɔ,
wode animuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire,
[na wode no asi wo nsa ano nnwuma so,]
wode nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nan ase.
Na sɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ n’ase yi, wannya biribiara a wamfa anhyɛ n’aseɛ. Na seesei deɛ, yɛnnya nhunuu sɛ wɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ n’ase. Na mmom, yɛhunu Yesu, deɛ berɛ tiawa bi mu, wɔbrɛɛ no ase senee abɔfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ ɔbɛnam Onyankopɔn adom so bɛka owuo ahwɛ ama nnipa nyinaa. Seesei ɛsiane owuo amanehunu nti, wɔde animuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire.

Na ɛfataa deɛ ne nti nnoɔma nyinaa wɔ hɔ na ɛnam ne so na nnoɔma nyinaa wɔ hɔ, deɛ ɔde mma bebree baa animuonyam mu no, sɛ ɔde wɔn nkwagyeɛ safohene nam amanehunu mu bɛkɔ pɛyɛ mu.
Na deɛ ɔte ho ne wɔn a wɔte wɔn ho nyinaa wɔ abɔseɛ baako, ne saa nti ɛnyɛ no aniwu sɛ ɔbɛfrɛ wɔn anuanom, sɛ:
Mɛbɔ wo din makyerɛ me nuanom,
asafo mu na mɛto ayeyie dwom mama woɔ.
Na bio:
Mede me ho bɛto ne so.
Na bio nso:
Hwɛ, me ne mma a Onyankopɔn de wɔn ama me no nie.

Enti sɛ mma no anya honam ne mogya korɔ no bie no, saa ara na ɔno nso faa mu bi, sɛ ɔnam owuo so bɛtu deɛ ɔwɔ owuo tumi a ɔne ɔbonsam no, na wagye wɔn a anka owuo ho hu nti wɔayɛ nkoa, nna a wɔde te aseɛ nyinaa. Na ampa ara, ɛnyɛ abɔfoɔ na ɔsɔ wɔn mu gye wɔn, na mmom Abraham asefoɔ na ɔsɔ wɔn mu gye wɔn. Enti ɛhiaa no sɛ ɔsɛ ne nuanom nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na wayɛ mmɔborɔhunu ne nokorɛ sɔfo panin, Nyankopɔn fam nnoɔma no mu, na wayɛ ɔman no bɔne ho mpata. Na ɛnam sɛ ɔno ara hunuu sɔ a wɔsɔɔ no hwɛeɛ mu amaneɛ nti, ɔtumi boa wɔn a wɔsɔ wɔn hwɛ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
